correctness.rationale: Exact unrestricted proof. The falling-factorial series converges coefficientwise on three-adic residue discs. Certified reductions modulo 9, 27 and 81 yield a bijective unit disc and a quadratic critical disc. The critical root is unique by contraction, has t0 congruent to 3 modulo 9, and its value c has valuation two, verified from D10/9 congruent to 18 modulo 27. A three-adic analytic coordinate change gives the exact shifted-square image; disjoint square-valuation strata yield Q_h, I_m and R_a for every a. The independent standard-library checker reproduces all levels a=1..9 and finite coefficient certificates; it is not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The established modular period, continuous interpolation, Hensel zero-lifting and prime-level Bell relations were identified as prior results. The complete cardinalities of attained derangement residues modulo all powers of three and the precise limiting image density were not established by the specifically inspected primary results. The proof treats the nonzero value fibers through a nondegenerate 3-adic quadratic critical point. This is a best-knowledge originality assessment, not proof against all historic literature.
residual_risks: The full Barsky 1981 article was not examined. Earlier general p-adic analytic results might contain a specialized derangement image computation.

value.rationale: The number of distinct residues attained modulo prime powers is a natural global range invariant, distinct from the known least period and zero-divisibility pattern. This result completely classifies the ternary image sizes for all powers, supplies their exact rational limiting density 725/972, and explains the non-surjectivity by a nondegenerate local critical point. Neither a routine single-index congruence nor a small finite table.
